Sangeet Night Planning Guide for Chandigarh Weddings

How to plan an unforgettable sangeet night in Chandigarh — themes, performances, decor and music.

Sangeet Planning

How to Plan the Perfect Sangeet Night in Chandigarh

The sangeet night is often the most anticipated event in a Punjabi wedding — full of music, dance performances and electric energy. Planning a great sangeet in Chandigarh takes preparation, creativity and the right vendors.

1. Choose the Right Venue

The venue sets the tone for your sangeet. Chandigarh has excellent options — banquet halls in Sector 8 and 34, farmhouses in Mohali, and hotel ballrooms in Panchkula. Make sure the venue can handle a proper DJ setup, stage for performances, and a dance floor.

2. DJ vs Live Band — Which is Right?

Most Chandigarh sangeets combine both — a live dhol for the energetic Bhangra moments and a professional DJ for the rest of the night. VR Productions works with Chandigarh's top DJs and live performers to create the perfect sound experience.

3. Choreography & Performances

Family performances are the heart of a sangeet night. Plan and rehearse family dance numbers 4–6 weeks in advance. Hire a choreographer for the main performances and ensure the MC has a tight running order to keep energy high all night.

4. Decor That Transforms the Space

Sangeet décor should feel festive, colourful and Instagram-worthy. Think neon signs, floral backdrops, LED dance floors and customised menus. VR Productions has in-house décor expertise to transform any venue in Chandigarh for your sangeet night.
